response.summary: All three digests match. Judged beside the five phase records (004, 008, 011, 015, 020), the shipped paths they name (src/gnd/rmap.py, src/gnd/export/ossie.py, src/gnd/export/ossie_relational.py, src/gnd/export/physical_binding.py, src/gnd/commands/export.py, src/gnd/ossie_import.py, src/gnd/input_policy.py), the normative sections and the cited tests. Every completion predicate as amended by plan section 11 has evidence that would fail if false: the three legacy files are pinned byte-for-byte with --ontology-only and without --physical-binding (test_t6_ontology_only_equals_the_ob1_baseline, test_t7_without_the_flag_the_relational_files_equal_the_baseline over the 82-entry baselines); read_binding is total over arbitrary bytes, each refusal a named BindingError rule (test_t8_arbitrary_bytes_are_refused_by_name, r1-F1/F2 regressions); is_regular_identifier and _quoted match the OB5 record, the oracle-lane note and the normative text; the A1-A16 amendments are each supported by the record that raised them, with the r2 wording kept above section 11; every Q-id raised in the records is dispositioned; missing external acceptance is stated plainly, not implied to be met. In the files the results list as carrying no review opinion I found no behavioural defect. Four low completeness items on the plan and delta follow; none blocks the demonstration.
